fred_macro_latest_vintage.limitation: Latest revised vintage; not point-in-time historical data. Weekly series require release-lag treatment.
fred_macro_latest_vintage.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

nyfed_sofr.limitation: Publication occurs after the effective date; targets and features must respect that lag.
nyfed_sofr.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

sec_nmfp.limitation: As-filed data may contain reporting errors and becomes available after month-end.

treasury_auctions.limitation: Announcement and result vintages must be separated to avoid using auction outcomes too early.
treasury_auctions.provider: U.S. Department of the Treasury Fiscal Data
